name: Web To Print Shop : Pricematrix
author: w2pshop

sections.description:
Web To Print Shop : Pricematrix Plugin

Web to Print Shop’s centralized pricing matrix is an intuitive calculator that is part of web to print’s comprehensive online print ordering system. The calculator takes various aspects into account, such as material type, size, volume discounts, international currencies, and shipping. The tool provides customers with an instant quote, offering them on-the-spot web to print pricing. It is centralized within the platform so that prices only need to be set up once, and then all future published products are easier to add.

Features

  • Excel Price Calculator
  • Price Estimator Library
  • Wide Format Capabilities
  • Instant Quotes

Use of External Services

This plugin communicates with our proprietary endpoints hosted at racadtech.com to validate API credentials and process price-matrix data for accurate display on the product page. The transmitted information includes your API credentials and the pricing data used to calculate product costs.
sections.installation:
Requires
Plugin: WooCommerce

  1. Unzip and upload contents of the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
